📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 2). Edges, disturbed ground, last year’s growth — you read a hillside like a menu and strip it clean.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.
This is home ground. You grew up on country like this.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Dwayne Neumann. Arborist. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Tote Bag, Oath Ring, Dispatcher's headset, Spare Socks, Home key. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walk
A woman, maybe 40s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
